note: Stated choices, one table (docs/coding-principles.md: centralize; prefer data over code). Read only through core.policy.value. A noise tolerance is never here: it is a measured uncertainty (targets.uncertainty) or not checked.

equal_speed_pct.reason: a whole-workload change within this many percent counts as equal speed: not a win and not a regression

tier_a_min_pct.reason: a gain of at least this many percent is a broad win, promotable by default when the guardrails pass

tier_b_min_pct.reason: a gain of at least this many percent is a residual win, promotable with clean rollback and no protected regression

protected_regression_max_pct.reason: a protected context that slows by more than this many percent fails the guardrail

cache_tier_plateau_share.reason: sweep points within this share of their run's median are one cache tier; a step to the next tier is larger

dram_full_read_share.reason: a role whose DRAM bytes are within this share of its weight bytes counts as reading its weights from DRAM

same_row_work_ratio.reason: input-side rows of one format whose work per launch is within this ratio are reported as one row

noisy_spread_pct.reason: a timed row whose samples spread more than this many percent (half of P90 - P10 over the median) is labelled noisy

noisy_floor_multiple.reason: a kernel whose median is under this multiple of the dispatch floor is mostly floor: sampled more and labelled noisy

at_ceiling_pct.reason: a kernel at or above this percent of its roofline is called at the ceiling

headroom_pct.reason: a kernel from this percent up to at_ceiling_pct is called moderate headroom; below it, large headroom

mostly_zero_share.reason: an output with at least this share of zeros is called mostly zero

low_correlation.reason: an output whose correlation with the reference is below this is called low correlation

gpu_busy_pct.reason: an Apple GPU whose lowest utilization read is at least this percent is in use by another program (the desktop alone reads 0 to 15)
